title: LGIC_NAMING round 1 -- the N3 item set (the namers LN-e-1 and LN-e-2 read this; the answer key is N3_KEY.json, which they do not read)
issued_by: 2.0.0_SA_COO~G at L6, from decomposition v3 section 3a.1
rule: each item is a NEW resource described in plain words plus its AWS node_type; no description spells a schema token; systems only from infra/logic/05_IDENTITY_SPINE.md (products mdpf, etfs; vendors schwab, blackdiamond, orion, eclipse, smartx, pathfinder, trueshares, ycharts)

items.description: The Lambda function that publishes Cottonwood's figures from the model-portfolio product (the model delivery product) every day. This is the example the outcome itself names.
The IAM role that the Black Diamond integration assumes when it fetches 49 Financial's daily session data from Black Diamond.
The EventBridge rule that starts the Orion ingest for Inflection once a day.
The Secrets Manager secret holding Schwab's API credentials used for 49 Financial.
The S3 bucket that holds Cottonwood's own data.
The S3 key, without the bucket, of Eclipse's silver table for Inflection named account_holdings, for the day 2026-09-14. Give the key only, up to and including the partition.
The IAM policy that lets the model-portfolio product's single shared publisher read every firm's gold data. The publisher serves all firms.
The dead-letter queue behind the ETF product's price-refresh queue, which is shared by every firm.
The CloudWatch alarm that fires when the daily model-portfolio publish for the demo firm fails.
The EventBridge Scheduler schedule that runs the SmartX platform export for 49 Financial once a week.
The ECS task definition that runs the Pathfinder ingest for the ETF product.
The SSM document that downloads Black Diamond files for Cottonwood.

The S3 key, without the bucket and without the file, of a NEW served family for the model-portfolio product for 49 Financial: one file per advisor, the table is advisor_books, the entity is the advisor keyed advisor_id, and the advisor id is A123. The file under it would be book.json; give the key up to and including the partition.
The S3 key, without the bucket, of the model-portfolio product's code bundle that builds its gold tier, shared across all firms. The bundle file is named mdpf-accrual-bridge.tar.gz.
The EC2 instance profile for the Orion runner host that builds Inflection's gold data.
The security group for the model-portfolio product's exporter host that serves Cottonwood.
The SNS topic for the ETF product's pipeline alerts, which is shared by every firm.
The DynamoDB table holding the model-portfolio product's delivery status for Inflection.
